products.name: iOS iPhone Shared Device Mode (Lockdown) with WebEx Calling — Commercial
products.short_description: Turn pooled iPhones into locked-down, shared calling appliances. Enrolled with no owner via a Device Enrollment Manager account, supervised via Apple Business Manager, kiosk-locked to Cisco Webex, and signed in with a shared organization account — managed at fleet scale in Microsoft Intune. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Shared iPhones, locked to one job: Cisco Webex calling

Plenty of teams need shared phones, not personal ones — pooled iPhones at a nurses' station, a warehouse floor, a hotel front desk, or a fleet of loaners that anyone on shift can pick up and use to make a call. Handed out as ordinary phones, they drift: apps get installed, settings get changed, each device ends up tied to whoever set it up, and nobody can tell which handset is healthy. This solution makes those iPhones locked-down, shared appliances in Microsoft Intune: enrolled with no user affinity via a Device Enrollment Manager (DEM) account, supervised via Apple Business Manager + ADE, put into kiosk lock-down that exposes only Cisco Webex, and signed in with a shared organization account.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant to design this. The package hands you the exact, field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a non-expert administrator can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell (Microsoft Graph) that checks tenant readiness, validates each shared phone, reports the whole fleet, and builds the dynamic shared-device group.

  • Simpler — exact Intune and Entra navigation in the right order: DEM enrollment, ABM/ADE supervision, a kiosk profile locked to Webex. Assign once to one shared-device group and every phone inherits the whole configuration.
  • Cheaper — one fixed, transparent price instead of an open meter. A comparable endpoint-management consulting engagement runs $1,500–$3,000 per day across several days; this is a fraction of that, with nothing left to bill.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with validation tests and clear pass/fail gates, proving a shared iPhone is DEM-enrolled, supervised, locked to Webex, and calling before you scale.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the shared-device model, the DEM / no-user-affinity design, kiosk lock-down, and the shared-account login model.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (DEM account, shared Webex account, APNs certificate, Apple Business Manager + ADE token, supervision, shared-device group, Cisco Webex app, Webex calling licensing, iOS version, network) with how to verify and how to implement it if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered, click-by-click steps across five phases: identity & Apple connection baseline, DEM/supervised no-affinity enrollment, kiosk lock-down to Cisco Webex, compliance & access, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — tenant-readiness discovery, shared-device validation (DEM/supervised/Webex), a fleet inventory report, safe remediation (clear a stray primary user), and a one-shot dynamic shared-device group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with clear pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once-to-the-fleet model.

The Phoenixtekk way

Every Phoenixtekk solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each one you deploy feels familiar and low-risk — and your team gets faster and more confident with every rollout. Buy once, deploy to unlimited devices, and reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A fleet of interchangeable, locked-down iPhones that do exactly one thing — Cisco Webex calling under a managed organization account — enrolled hands-off and managed at fleet scale by a single administrator in a controlled pilot.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • IOSSDM-DeviceReport.ps1 — inventory of shared iOS iPhones (DEM-enrolled, supervised, no user)
    • IOSSDM-Discovery.ps1 — tenant readiness check for iOS iPhone Shared Device Mode (lockdown + Webex)
    • IOSSDM-Remediation.ps1 — safe audit/fixes for the shared iOS iPhone fleet
    • IOSSDM-Set-SharedDeviceTargeting.ps1 — create the dynamic 'iOS – Shared Devices' group
    • IOSSDM-Validation.ps1 — prove a shared iPhone is DEM-enrolled, supervised, locked, and has Webex

Delivered as a branded Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse across unlimited devices.
